title: DCP Discrete Sine vs. Flat Box Window Shift-Autocorrelation and Quadratic Dephasing Bridge
claims: The discrete sine window on {0, ..., P-1} has exact shift autocorrelation gamma_{sin}(Delta; P) = (1 - Delta/P)*cos(pi*Delta/P) + (1/P)*(sin(pi*Delta/P)/sin(pi/P)), with unit-shift overlap gamma_{sin}(1; P) == (1 - 1/P)*cos(pi/P) + 1/P.
Unit-shift dephasing loss scales quadratically as pi^2/(2*P^2) for the sine window vs. linearly as 1/P for the box window, while near the edge Delta = P - 1 the box window retains larger overlap.
